RMSF_definition: Aggregate raw_means.RMSF_MAE_A and primary paired RMSF_MAE_A are residue-profile MAE.Amplitude-bin entries explicitly labeled atom-profile use a different observable.See paired_static_protein100_result.json for both definitions and now-complete matched B results.
paired_array_definition: Candidate minus reference:mean,lower,upper95percent paired system-bootstrap interval.Marginal exploratory intervals,not multiplicity-adjusted;amplitude ratios are not universally lower-is-better.
versus_hv: Bond,clash,MSD,angle and torsion-increment errors improve.RMSF-MAE interval includes zero.CA position and pair-distance path fair scores improve;both increment-path score intervals include zero.
versus_PVB: Bond,clash,MSD and angle remain worse.RMSF-MAE and all four CA path fair scores improve;torsion-increment difference unresolved.Native input/training/resource differences remain,so neither reference-wide superiority nor strict state-only causal effect is established.

temporal_order.paired_method: Same molvid.evaluation.ca_detail.system_estimate applied to differences of matched per_system entries in temporal_order100_advanced/summary.json;no subtraction of marginal CI endpoints.
temporal_order.interpretation: Static exposure improves temporal order at several lags,but the absolute lag1 gain remains far below MD and increment anticorrelation remains near independent-frame behavior.It is incorrect both to say no temporal benefit and to claim temporal dynamics solved.

motion_bins.definition: Original TRAIN-frozen displacement cutoffs1.5064689185/2.1366116115A;all96conditions retained.Low44,medium26,high26;systems overlap between bins.
motion_bins.interpretation: Bond and clash improve in every bin.Low-motion RMSF/MSD improve;medium RMSF improves but MSD interval includes zero.High-motion RMSF/MSD improvements are unresolved and already-low amplitude is further suppressed.Torsion-increment improves in high bin but worsens in low bin.No large-motion success claim.

spatial_cooperation.interpretation: Within-step spatial coupling remains substantial.Covalent/contact cosine-error changes versus MD-only A are unresolved,while contact relative-increment fair score improves.Contact fair score and both cosine-error observables improve versus h/v/PVB;covalent fair-score differences remain unresolved.No equilibrium covariance claim.

limitations: One followup training seed,48 reused development systems,two draws per condition;not independent confirmation.
RMSF/MSD aggregate differences versus MD-only A are small and their marginal intervals nearly touch zero.Geometry gains are much larger.
